summary: deeptime is a general-purpose Python library for time-series and dynamical-modeling. It focuses on learning dynamical systems from time-series data, not specific to molecular dynamics. Core capabilities include estimating slow collective coordinates, state decompositions, Markov models, Koopman models, and deep time-lagged representations. Key model families are TICA, which finds slow directions; VAMP, a variational approach for Markov processes; VAMPNet, a neural network-based time-lagged representation; Markov State Models (MSM); Hidden Markov Models; and Koopman models. deeptime expects featurized time-series inputs from various sources. It does not perform trajectory parsing, force-field calculations, or topology selection. deeptime integrates well with preprocessing tools like CPPTRAJ,MDAnalysis,andSAWNERGY,servingasapowerfulback-endfordynamicalanalysisandrepresentationlearning.
title: deeptime
